readings.Aries: You are already past the point of hesitation. You just haven't caught up to yourself yet. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Taurus: Comfort is not the same as safety. The distinction matters today. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Gemini: You've been circling the truth. Land. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Cancer: Your sensitivity is precision, not weakness. The readings it gives are accurate. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Leo: You want the room. You also sometimes want to be unknown. Both are real. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Virgo: Something you do automatically would astound someone else if they could see it. Notice your competence. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Libra: Other people's approval has weight in your emotional system. Today, your own approval matters more. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Scorpio: You are harder to hurt than you used to be. Some of that armour is now in the way. The first instinct was right.
readings.Sagittarius: Your optimism is accurate. It is also sometimes premature. Check the current conditions. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: You are further along than you think. The metric you're using is incorrect. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: Someone is trying to reach you through the systems you've put up. Let them. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Pisces: What you're calling chaos is actually pattern — you can see it if you look from further away. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
